About Lyra Health
Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.

About The Role

Lyra Health’s Clinical Strategy team is seeking a seasoned Senior Operations Lead for a high-impact, 6-month contract engagement focused on driving our Joint Commission (TJC) Behavioral Health Care and Human Services (BHC) accreditation readiness.

This role sits at the intersection of clinical strategy, regulatory execution, and cross-functional project management. Acting as the primary project lead, you will bridge the gap between Clinical Strategy, Clinical Operations, and key cross-functional teams to drive our accreditation roadmap.

This role is ideal for a senior healthcare project manager who excels at translating complex regulatory mandates or compliance standards into actionable project plans. While familiarity with Joint Commission standards is preferred, we are primarily seeking an exceptional operational lead who can quickly get up to speed on TJC requirements, partner with clinical domain experts, and drive execution. You are a self-directed player-coach who is comfortable getting "in the weeds" with workstream leads to build compliance documentation while also zooming out to present a 30,000-foot risk assessment to leadership.

","id":"35bffe8b-ac9f-4749-ba4c-5f3a4d2bd77d","lists":[{"text":"What You’ll Do (6-Month Scope) ","content":"

As a senior contractor, you will hit the ground running and lead the execution of our TJC survey readiness roadmap:

  • Roadmap & Work Plan Ownership: Refine, maintain, and drive the master Project Work Plan for TJC Behavioral Health and Telehealth accreditation readiness, establishing clear workstream milestones across clinical and operational teams.

  • Gap Analysis & Risk Mitigation: Continuously identify gaps, compliance risks, and cross-functional dependencies; proactively update the roadmap and implement risk mitigation strategies.

  • Workstream Facilitation: Partner directly with workstream leads to deep-dive into specific TJC standards. Develop supporting materials and process documentation as needed.

  • Mock Survey & Readiness Execution: Organize and project manage internal mock audits, tracer activities, and readiness drills to ensure operational teams are fully prepared for survey execution.

  • Governance & Cross-Functional Alignment: Establish clear communication cadences across stakeholders (live working groups, asynchronous updates, and project dashboards) to drive cross-functional accountability.

  • Executive Visibility: Develop concise, data-driven written updates for senior leadership to highlight progress, key milestones, and critical risks.

    • "},{"text":"Requirements:","content":"

  • 10+ years of healthcare project management, healthcare operations, or management consulting experience, preferably within high-growth health tech or clinical environments

  • Demonstrated track record of leading complex, cross-functional regulatory, compliance, or accreditation readiness initiatives from gap analysis through execution

  • Exceptional strategic and project management skills with the ability to influence cross-functional peers and senior leadership without direct authority

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; proven ability to distill complex clinical insights and regulatory requirements into actionable executive summaries

  • A highly organized self-starter who thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments and can create structure out of ambiguity

  • Deep passion for expanding access to high-quality, evidence-based mental health care

    • "},{"text":"Preferred Qualifications:","content":"

  • Direct experience or familiarity with the accreditation process (e.g., The Joint Commission, CARF, NCQA, or other), specifically within Behavioral Health Care and Human Services (BHC) or virtual/telehealth models

    About Lyra Health
    Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.

    About the Role
    As a Clinical Care Navigator, you’ll provide compassionate, timely clinical support to clients navigating a wide range of mental health, behavioral health, and life challenges. You’ll use your clinical expertise to assess needs and risk, provide brief interventions and crisis support, and connect clients with the right care and resources. In this fast-paced, high-volume role, you’ll help remove barriers to care through personalized support, making it easier for clients to take the next step toward connecting to care.
     
    This role may be a good fit for you if you’re:
    • A strong written and verbal communicator, with sound clinical judgment, excellent time-management skills, and the ability to confidently navigate a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
    • You’re skilled in brief clinical support, risk assessment, crisis response, and connecting people to the right care and resources.
    • You’re comfortable using technology to support your work, adaptable to change, and bring a growth mindset to your practice.
    • Most importantly, you’re passionate about making high-quality mental health care more accessible and helping clients get the support they need, when they need it most.
    You must be able to work the following shift(s):
    Tuesday - Saturday 9:30am - 6pm PST (10:30am - 7pm MT / 11:30am - 8pm CT / 12:30pm - 9pm ET)
    Sunday - Thursday 9:30am - 6pm PT (10:30am - 7pm MT / 11:30am - 8pm CT / 12:30pm - 9pm ET)
     
    Weekends include a 10% shift pay differential!
     
    This role can be carried out fully remote/virtually. Remote candidates must be physically located within the United States.
    ","id":"0a78eca7-131e-4304-9687-05c2a6b17b2f","lists":[{"text":"Responsibilities","content":"
  • Provide compassionate, timely, evidence-informed clinical support to clients experiencing a range of emotional, behavioral, and situational concerns, including crisis and elevated-risk situations.
  • Conduct risk assessments and safety planning when indicated, and use appropriate de-escalation, rapport building, and evidence based coping interventions to provide clients with in the moment support.
  • Provide brief support and resources across a broad range of presenting concerns, including mental health, substance use, relationship and family concerns, workplace stress, grief, and other life challenges.
  • Support clients with connecting to Lyra resources and care options aligned with their clinical needs and preferences.
  • Utilize Lyra’s technology platforms, clinical resources, and provider network to facilitate efficient access to appropriate services.
  • Provide assisted booking and other care-navigation support to help clients successfully connect with recommended providers and services.
  • Conduct follow-up outreach when indicated to support continuity of care, reassess risk, and address barriers to connecting to ongoing care.
  • Respond effectively to a high-volume, high acuity inbound call queue, while maintaining excellent clinical quality, appropriate and timely documentation, client engagement, and adherence to established internal protocols and procedures.
  • Maintain accurate, timely, and clinically appropriate documentation of client interactions, assessments, interventions, referrals, and follow-up.
  • Collaborate with relevant Lyra teams to support safe, effective, and seamless client care.

    About Lyra Health
    Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.

    About the Role
    As a Clinical Care Navigator, you’ll provide compassionate, timely clinical support to clients navigating a wide range of mental health, behavioral health, and life challenges. You’ll use your clinical expertise to assess needs and risk, provide brief interventions and crisis support, and connect clients with the right care and resources. In this fast-paced, high-volume role, you’ll help remove barriers to care through personalized support, making it easier for clients to take the next step toward connecting to care.

    This role may be a good fit for you if you’re:
    • A strong written and verbal communicator, with sound clinical judgment, excellent time-management skills, and the ability to confidently navigate a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
    • You’re skilled in brief clinical support, risk assessment, crisis response, and connecting people to the right care and resources.
    • You’re comfortable using technology to support your work, adaptable to change, and bring a growth mindset to your practice.
    • Most importantly, you’re passionate about making high-quality mental health care more accessible and helping clients get the support they need, when they need it most.
    You must be able to work the following shift(s):
    Tuesday - Saturday 9:30am - 6pm PST (10:30am - 7pm MT / 11:30am - 8pm CT / 12:30pm - 9pm ET)
    Sunday - Thursday 9:30am - 6pm PT (10:30am - 7pm MT / 11:30am - 8pm CT / 12:30pm - 9pm ET)
     
    Weekends include a 10% shift pay differential!
     
    This role's internal title is: Clinical Care Navigator. The position can be carried out fully remote/virtually. Remote candidates must be physically located within the United States.
    ","id":"ccb94da6-3d56-47f3-bc1b-75b80464927d","lists":[{"text":"Responsibilities","content":"
  • Provide compassionate, timely, evidence-informed clinical support to clients experiencing a range of emotional, behavioral, and situational concerns, including crisis and elevated-risk situations.
  • Conduct risk assessments and safety planning when indicated, and use appropriate de-escalation, rapport building, and evidence based coping interventions to provide clients with in the moment support.
  • Provide brief support and resources across a broad range of presenting concerns, including mental health, substance use, relationship and family concerns, workplace stress, grief, and other life challenges.
  • Support clients with connecting to Lyra resources and care options aligned with their clinical needs and preferences.
  • Utilize Lyra’s technology platforms, clinical resources, and provider network to facilitate efficient access to appropriate services.
  • Provide assisted booking and other care-navigation support to help clients successfully connect with recommended providers and services.
  • Conduct follow-up outreach when indicated to support continuity of care, reassess risk, and address barriers to connecting to ongoing care.
  • Respond effectively to a high-volume, high acuity inbound call queue, while maintaining excellent clinical quality, appropriate and timely documentation, client engagement, and adherence to established internal protocols and procedures.
  • Maintain accurate, timely, and clinically appropriate documentation of client interactions, assessments, interventions, referrals, and follow-up.
  • Collaborate with relevant Lyra teams to support safe, effective, and seamless client care.

Candidates without a state license to deliver mental health services, independently, will not be considered (with the exception of the RN license)
  • RNs must have two years of specific behavioral health experience including risk assessment and safety planning.
  • All other licensures must have two years post license experience (EAP/clinical call center experience preferred)
  • Significant experience managing high-acuity clinical situations (e.g., active suicidality/homicidality, NSSIB, mandated reporting)
  • Must be Bilingual, Spanish-speaking 
  • Must be a full time resident of the United States; work cannot be completed from outside the United States.

    About the Role: 

    As a Channel Manager at Lyra Health, you will operate as the general manager and strategic commercial driver for a portfolio of key health plan and other co-selling partner relationships (including but not limited to large payer organizations). In this role, you are not just maintaining existing relationships—you are directly responsible for end-to-end partner growth, strategic alignment, deal strategy, and joint commercial execution.

    You will combine sharp sales acumen with rigorous cross-functional project leadership to co-sell, architect winning deal strategies, and expand Lyra’s footprint across partner ecosystems. You are expected to proactively identify growth opportunities, lead joint go-to-market (GTM) initiatives, and directly drive new Annual Contract Value (ACV) bookings by embedding Lyra deeply into your partners' core commercial strategy.

    ","id":"818b2687-5d99-44f1-9d81-8bae8dc65c53","lists":[{"text":"Responsibilities","content":"

    1. Deal Strategy & Co-Selling Leadership

  • Actively manage multiple sales motions (co-selling, reselling, etc.) alongside partner sales reps and internal Lyra Employer Solutions Sales on opportunities, architecting tailored deal strategies and value propositions to maximize deal size and ACV.

  • Serve as a strategic deal consultant to guide sales teams on navigating complex health plan partner sales motions, overcoming competitive threats, and positioning Lyra effectively.

  • Identify and unblock deal friction throughout the buyer journey to accelerate deal velocity and boost close rates across indirect channels.

    • 2. End-to-End Partnership Ownership & Strategy

  • Serve as the ultimate business owner for your assigned partner portfolio, orchestrating long-term partnership strategy, quarterly executive business reviews (QBRs), and joint annual revenue plans.

  • Proactively manage the overall health, performance, and strategic alignment of each partner account—from initial onboarding and co-marketing to ongoing integration, retention, and commercial expansion.

  • Establish multi-year partner growth roadmaps that align partner incentives with Lyra’s overarching commercial goals.

    • 3. Cross-Functional Project Leadership

  • Mobilize and lead cross-functional project teams across Product, Marketing, Sales Engineering, Legal, and Customer Success to execute complex strategic initiatives on schedule.

  • Lead high-impact projects (e.g., custom product integrations, GTM product launches, new partner packaging/pricing tier launches) from initial scoping to execution.

  • Drive accountability across both internal departments and external partner stakeholders to ensure seamless operational execution.

    • 4. Proactive Growth, Initiative & Channel Analytics

  • Identify untapped market segments, prospective account lists, and novel positioning strategies within your partner accounts to unlock new revenue streams.

  • Establish, analyze, and report on core channel metrics (pipeline generation, win rates, ACV influence, partner-sourced opportunities, deal velocity).

  • Use performance data and CRM tools to continuously refine partner strategy, optimize sales enablement, and address operational bottlenecks.

    • "},{"text":"Qualifications","content":"

  • 8+ years of combined experience in direct enterprise sales (Quota-carrying AE/AM), strategic partner management, or channel business development within health plans, SaaS, employer benefits tech, or digital health.

  • Deep health plan expertise & political acumen: Substantial experience operating inside or alongside large health plan organizations, with a proven ability to navigate complex partner bureaucracies, leverage existing health plan sales infrastructure, and cultivate trusted relationships with senior client-facing executives.

  • Proven track record of quota ownership or direct accountability for revenue targets (New ACV, partner-influenced revenue).

  • Demonstrated deal-level strategy skills: Deep understanding of enterprise B2B sales cycles, multi-stakeholder navigation, consultative selling, and competitive deal positioning.

  • Exceptional project leadership & ownership: Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives, manage dependencies, drive accountability, and bring projects across the finish line independently.

  • Entrepreneurial initiative: A proactive self-starter who takes complete ownership of their portfolio, builds partnership strategies, and proactively solves systemic blockers.

  • Strong financial and business acumen with comfort analyzing CRM data and pipeline performance to make strategic decisions.

  • Ability and willingness to travel 50%

  • Bachelor’s degree required; prior experience in employer-sponsored healthcare, behavioral health, or health plan distribution is strongly preferred.

    About the Role

    The Client Support Specialist serves as the critical first point of contact for Lyra clients seeking high-quality mental health care. This is a vital, client-facing role that supports individuals beginning their care journey.

    About Lyra

    Lyra Health is the leading provider of mental health solutions for employers supporting more than 20 million people globally. The company has delivered 13 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 20 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.

    About the Role

    Key areas of focus include overseeing clinical team management and consultation, ensuring quality and compliance with local regulations and Lyra standards, maintaining in-country clinical knowledge and infrastructure records, and providing direct leadership, development, and training for therapists and counsellors.

    Location: Singapore, to be based on-site.

    Hours:  9am to 6pm. 

    The role is a permanent five (5) day a week role (Monday to Friday).

    Flexibility: The successful candidate must be flexible to work outside of standard hours to accommodate the global nature of the business and collaborate effectively with international teams across multiple time zones.

    WiFi: While working off-site/remotely, the individual is expected to have reliable backup power supply and a strong, stable Wi-Fi connection as these are essential requirements for effectively performing in a remote capacity.

    ","id":"d9106604-ad8c-4235-9536-4e875113e6fa","lists":[{"text":"Responsibilities","content":"

    Clinical Team Management:

  • Develop and implement a robust framework for clinical supervision and consultation within the Singapore operation, aligning with Lyra's global standards and promoting the professional welfare and development of clinical staff.

  • Facilitate regular case consultations and peer learning sessions to enhance clinical skills and problem-solving within the team.

  • Support employee counsellor performance management, ensuring all team members meet and exceed clinical expectations and performance metrics.

    • Quality & Compliance Management:

  • Support and conduct rigorous case reviews for compliance with Lyra's internal standards of operations and clinical protocols, ensuring the highest level of service quality.

  • Oversee and ensure adherence to all local (Singaporean) and international clinical protocols, standards, and procedures in close collaboration with the Clinical Operations Manager.

  • Contribute to the implementation and maintenance of rigorous quality assurance processes to ensure comprehensive compliance with Singaporean healthcare regulations and Lyra's standards.

  • Work closely with the Clinical Operations Manager to ensure that clinical services delivered by the team are in line with Lyra's global standards and consistently meet customer Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

  • Collaborate with the International Clinical Lead to address audit findings and implement corrective actions.

    • In-Country Clinical Infrastructure & Knowledge Management:

  • Take full responsibility for maintaining accurate and up-to-date records of the clinical operations in Singapore, specifically concerning:

  • In-country mental health infrastructure (e.g., public and private mental health services, referral pathways, specialized clinics).

  • Legislation that impacts service delivery (e.g., privacy laws, licensing requirements, professional conduct guidelines).

  • Cultural nuances and sensitivities relevant to mental health service delivery in Singapore.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on the Singaporean mental health landscape for the clinical team and broader organization.

    • Team Management & Development:

  • Directly line manage and provide performance feedback to therapists and counsellors, conducting regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and setting clear goals.

  • Identify training needs within the team and collaborate on the development and delivery of targeted clinical training programs.

  • Foster a supportive and collaborative team environment that encourages professional growth and adherence to Lyra's values.

    • Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or higher in Clinical/Counseling/Industrial Psychology, Healthcare Administration, Operations or Business Administration (with Mental Healthcare experience), or a related field preferred. 

  • Registered Clinical Counselor or Full Member status with the Singapore Association for Counselling (SAC) or equivalent recognized professional board.

    "},{"text":"Resumen de la posición","content":"

    El Consultor Administrativo Emocional es responsable de gestionar de manera integral el ciclo de atención de los clientes de Lyra México y Central América, coordinando la logística de citas presenciales y virtuales con la red de afiliados.

    Garantiza la continuidad del servicio mediante el seguimiento puntual de agendas, la resolución de dudas y la correcta comunicación entre clientes, consultores emocionales y psicólogos afiliados. Asimismo, realiza el registro de los casos en la plataforma Salesforce, asegurando que el proceso administrativo sea claro y amigable para el cliente, contribuyendo a una experiencia integral de bienestar al hacer uso del programa.

    "},{"text":"Principales funciones","content":"

    Coordinación de citas presenciales y virtuales: Recepción de solicitudes de coordinación de sesiones, solicitud de disponibilidad y opciones de cita a los psicólogos de la red de afiliados de Lyra México y Central America, coordinación de sesiones entre el cliente y el afiliado, envío de correos electrónicos de confirmación de citas y asignación de tareas de seguimiento al Consultor Emocional que deriva el servicio.

    Seguimiento a inasistencias: Recepción de reportes de inasistencia por parte de los psicólogos afiliados vía telefónica o WhatsApp, contacto inmediato con el cliente para dar seguimiento, así como la agenda y/o re agenda de citas vía telefónica y por correo electrónico.

    Atención a clientes y afiliados: Resolución de dudas relacionadas con el proceso de atención presencial o virtual y actualización de sesiones en los casos con servicios presenciales o virtuales.

    Gestión de casos en plataforma Salesforce (Connected Calendar): Registro de casos, envío de correos de confirmación de cita y formatos correspondientes a los afiliados, recepción de retroalimentación, seguimiento a la primera sesión con cliente y afiliado, seguimiento final con cliente y afiliado, cierre administrativo de casos de origen Calendario Conectado y registro de evaluaciones pre y post CORE en los casos correspondientes.

    "},{"text":"Resumen de la posición","content":"

    El Consultor Administrativo Emocional es responsable de gestionar de manera integral el ciclo de atención de los clientes de Lyra México y Central América, coordinando la logística de citas presenciales y virtuales con la red de afiliados.

    Garantiza la continuidad del servicio mediante el seguimiento puntual de agendas, la resolución de dudas y la correcta comunicación entre clientes, consultores emocionales y psicólogos afiliados. Asimismo, realiza el registro de los casos en la plataforma Salesforce, asegurando que el proceso administrativo sea claro y amigable para el cliente, contribuyendo a una experiencia integral de bienestar al hacer uso del programa.

    "},{"text":"Principales funciones","content":"

    Coordinación de citas presenciales y virtuales: Recepción de solicitudes de coordinación de sesiones, solicitud de disponibilidad y opciones de cita a los psicólogos de la red de afiliados de Lyra México y Central America, coordinación de sesiones entre el cliente y el afiliado, envío de correos electrónicos de confirmación de citas y asignación de tareas de seguimiento al Consultor Emocional que deriva el servicio.

    Seguimiento a inasistencias: Recepción de reportes de inasistencia por parte de los psicólogos afiliados vía telefónica o WhatsApp, contacto inmediato con el cliente para dar seguimiento, así como la agenda y/o re agenda de citas vía telefónica y por correo electrónico.

    Atención a clientes y afiliados: Resolución de dudas relacionadas con el proceso de atención presencial o virtual y actualización de sesiones en los casos con servicios presenciales o virtuales.

    Gestión de casos en plataforma Salesforce (Connected Calendar): Registro de casos, envío de correos de confirmación de cita y formatos correspondientes a los afiliados, recepción de retroalimentación, seguimiento a la primera sesión con cliente y afiliado, seguimiento final con cliente y afiliado, cierre administrativo de casos de origen Calendario Conectado y registro de evaluaciones pre y post CORE en los casos correspondientes.

    About Lyra Health
    Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.

    About the Role

    Lyra Health is looking for a strategic and AI-savvy storyteller to reimagine how we create, manage, and scale compelling narratives across the full pursuit journey, from the initial RFP through finalist presentations and deal closing. Combining sharp writing, strategic messaging and process discipline, you'll help our Sales and Customer Success teams tell stronger, buyer-centric stories that communicate Lyra's value.

    Sitting within Lyra’s Solution Marketing team, you’ll lead Lyra's proposal content strategy, strengthening the quality and impact of our RFPs. You'll own the messaging foundation within our proposal response platform, while putting emerging AI capabilities into practice to improve first-pass drafting, personalization, and quality.

    Beyond proposals, you'll help shape how generative and agentic AI transform content development across Marketing and Sales. Working closely with Product Marketing, Segment and Solution Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success, you'll experiment with new technologies and develop smarter, more scalable approaches that improve efficiency and storytelling effectiveness across the full pursuit journey.

    ","id":"65f1b251-1ae3-4518-bead-3eceaf9281e1","lists":[{"text":"Responsibilities","content":"

  • Translate complex product capabilities, clinical outcomes, and value propositions into compelling, differentiated narratives tailored to buyer needs, segments, and business priorities.

  • Apply generative and agentic AI to rethink content workflows, improving how teams discover, draft, personalize, and refine content while reducing manual effort and strengthening response quality.

  • Experiment with emerging AI technologies to create more connected, scalable content experiences across the pursuit journey, from market narratives and RFP responses to finalist presentations, ensuring a consistent and compelling story of Lyra's value.

  • Own the content strategy, architecture, and quality of Responsive, ensuring our proposal knowledge base reflects Lyra's latest positioning, product capabilities, and proof points. Manage governance and content standards that improve AI retrieval, response accuracy, and overall quality.

  • Turn recurring RFP questions, buyer priorities, and content gaps into actionable insights that strengthen Lyra's positioning, connect messaging across the pursuit journey, and more clearly communicate our value to buyers.

  • Partner with Proposal Managers, Writers, Product Marketing, Segment and Solution Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to close messaging gaps, establish content validation processes, and develop stronger, reusable narratives across the pursuit journey.

    • "},{"text":"Qualifications","content":"

  • 8+ years in content strategy, product marketing, solution marketing, proposal content, or a related field, with a strong foundation in positioning, messaging, and persuasive business writing.

  • Demonstrated experience applying generative and agentic AI capabilities to content development, with curiosity and enthusiasm for experimenting with new tools, workflows, and approaches.

  • Exceptional writing and editing skills, with the ability to simplify complex information, articulate differentiation, and create compelling narratives for business audiences.

  • A proactive, experimental mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities, challenge existing approaches, and turn new ideas into practical improvements.

  • Demonstrated experience both using and managing proposal management platforms such as Responsive, including hands-on ownership of content libraries, knowledge architecture, content governance, and AI-powered response capabilities.

  • Strong understanding of the RFP and complex sales process, including how messaging, positioning, buyer priorities, and competitive differentiation influence a pursuit.

  • Experience developing and maintaining reusable content that can be adapted for different audiences, segments, and use cases.

  • Strong strategic judgment, with the ability to evaluate not only whether content is accurate, but whether it is relevant, persuasive, and effective.

  • Ability to translate complex product, technical, or industry information into clear, customer-focused messaging.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience partnering with Product Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and other stakeholders to align messaging and content priorities.

  • Experience in health care, benefits, or another complex or regulated industry is a plus.

    About Lyra

    Lyra Health is the leading provider of mental health solutions for employers supporting more than 20 million people globally. The company has delivered 13 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 20 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.

    Lyra is looking for a visionary and strategic Director, International Product to lead and scale our global mental health offerings. As Lyra grows around the world, you’ll shape how we deliver high-quality, culturally relevant care to members, providers, and employers in every market we serve.

    You’ll serve as the connective tissue between our global commercial ambitions and technical execution, guiding multiple simultaneous initiatives and building a platform-first, repeatable engine for international growth. Working alongside senior leadership, you’ll own the strategic vision, delivery, and performance of the international product suite.

    The leaders who thrive in this role pair high standards with real care for the people around them. They build strong relationships across the organization, earn influence through trust and clarity, and bring steady, energizing leadership to their teams, especially when the path ahead is uncertain

    ","id":"fe92d139-8edb-454e-88ff-21584411004e","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do:","content":"
  • Global Product Vision & Strategy: Define the multi-year vision and roadmap for Lyra’s international product suite, grounded in market analysis, competitive insight, and firsthand understanding of the members, providers, and clients we serve in each region. Synthesize global market signals into a clear point of view on where to invest for the greatest impact for global employers.
  • Product Scope & Ownership: Hold full lifecycle responsibility for the scoping, development, and delivery of member experiences and the underlying platform infrastructure across four major product lines: International Lyra Workforce Mental Health (WFMH), Global Lyra Wellbeing, 10 Local Lyra Wellbeing products, and other product surface areas as needed.
  • Platform-First Scale: Lead the evolution of our international offerings onto a unified global platform, with automated workflows that make each new client launch faster and more repeatable than the last. Champion the localization of core capabilities, including billing, eligibility, and provider management, so they flex gracefully across markets.
  • Roadmap Stewardship: Balance the needs of today’s clients with durable, long-term platform investments. Make clear, well-reasoned tradeoffs, explain the “why” behind them in a way that brings people along, and have the conviction to say “not yet” when that’s what best serves members and the business.
  • Leadership & Team Development: Build and lead the International Product team. Hire and grow exceptional people, including leaders whose strengths go beyond your own, and invest in their development through candid, caring feedback and meaningful ownership. Your success is measured by how well your team thrives: clearing the path, providing context, and creating the conditions for others to do their best work.
  • Business Ownership & Resourcing: Create and manage the annual budget for International Product. Assess resourcing needs and build compelling business cases to secure the investment needed to reach ambitious growth targets.
  • Cost-to-Serve & Performance Insight: Partner with the Data organization to build a single, trusted view of international performance, giving leadership clear visibility into margins, ROI, and utilization. Define and track the product metrics that measure success, and identify opportunities to streamline and automate so global products are built for long-term profitability.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Serve as the central connector across Product, Engineering, Data, Operations, Clinical Governance, Legal, and Compliance. Build trusted relationships across regions and time zones, including in our local operations work toward win-win outcomes amid competing priorities, and ensure clinical quality and local regulatory requirements are built into the product lifecycle from the start.
  • Go-To-Market Partnership: Act as a trusted partner to Go-To-Market and Client Services teams. Serve as the product voice in high-stakes, C-level client conversations and complex RFPs, bringing the technical and clinical confidence that helps Lyra win and retain large-scale global contracts.
  • AI-Enabled Product Excellence: Maintain a high bar for product craft and apply AI with purpose, both in our products, where it can meaningfully expand access and improve care, and in how we work. Model how AI can accelerate research, synthesis, planning, and execution, and help your team adopt tools and practices that drive efficiency, effectiveness, and happiness.
    • "},{"text":"What You'll Bring: ","content":"
  • Experience: Several years in product management, strategy, or technical operations.
  • Leadership: Several years of people leadership, with a track record of building strong teams and coaching talent to grow beyond their current roles.
  • Global Product Expertise: Experience launching and scaling products across multiple countries, including localizing for language, culture, and care norms, and navigating regional privacy and regulatory frameworks (e.g., GDPR, data residency). A natural instinct to design for local context, informed by real cultural fluency.
  • Platform & Enterprise Architecture: Deep understanding of bringing multiple systems together onto a unified global platform and reducing the effort required for each new client launch.
  • Commercial & Financial Acumen: Advanced skills in multivariable planning, budget ownership, and resource forecasting in a complex, matrixed environment. You think like a business owner and use data on product health, margin, ROI, and utilization to guide strategy.
  • Executive Influence & Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication. You can distill complexity into a crisp narrative, write a document that drives a decision, and adapt your message for engineers, clinicians, and C-level executives alike. A demonstrated track record of influencing senior leaders and key external stakeholders through credibility and trust, along with strong negotiation skills.
  • High Performance under Complexity: Ability to analyze changing, multivariable situations and set objectives with high impact on company goals. You make sound calls with incomplete information, move comfortably between the details and the big picture, keep momentum when plans shift, and stay composed and solutions-oriented when headwinds arise.
  • Practical AI Fluency: Hands-on experience using AI to meaningfully accelerate your own work and your team’s, with the discernment to know where it adds real value.
  • Culture & Psychological Safety: A model of Lyra’s values who fosters psychological safety across the team, welcomes nuanced feedback, and makes it safe for team members to voice differing opinions. You hold strong opinions loosely, change your mind when the evidence warrants, and share credit freely.
  • Mission & People Focus: A passion for Lyra’s mission. Your curiosity and empathy come naturally: they show up in the questions you ask, the time you spend with members, providers, and clients, and the products you build as a result.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree (or international equivalent) required; MBA or equivalent professional experience preferred.

    About Lyra Health
    Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.

    About the Role: 

    As our department scales, we are seeking a Director of Engagement Strategy to lead high-impact initiatives that connect more people to care through thoughtful, data-informed marketing.

    Reporting directly to the Senior Director, Customer Marketing, you will drive strategic member communication programs across our book of business, with special attention paid to our largest, most complex accounts. You will manage a team of 7 Engagement Strategy Managers, acting as a player-coach who elevates the team's focus from execution to high-value strategic consulting and operational excellence.

    In this role, you will transform customer engagement by shifting employers from basic benefits promotion to embedding Lyra’s marketing within their broader operational and business goals. You will partner cross-functionally with Customer Success, Operations, Product & Brand Marketing, Analytics, and Finance to build scalable frameworks that meet customer needs, drive Net Revenue Retention (NRR), and help Lyra scale efficiently.

    ","id":"aeb77e3c-063e-4a22-b95c-bd035c391a65","lists":[{"text":"Responsibilities","content":"

  • Team Leadership & Coaching: Manage and mentor a team of 7 marketing professionals. Provide clear guardrails and accountability to help them build data-driven consulting skills and lead high-level account strategy.

  • Strategic Planning & Scale: Own the annual strategy, budget, and quarterly initiatives for your team. Turn individual account successes into repeatable playbooks and scalable marketing frameworks that reverse book-of-business utilization declines and improve overall team performance.

  • Operational Strategy & AI Integration: Establish the team's operational strategy and governance model, driving scale and consistency by building out standardized tools, templates, and leveraging emerging technologies like AI to maximize impact and efficiency.

  • Data-Driven Intervention: Translate data and funnel metrics into clear, customer-facing stories. Proactively identify underperforming accounts and build targeted marketing turnaround plans for your team and Customer Success to implement.

  • Playbook Standardization: Create and maintain a library of scalable marketing playbooks categorized by industry (e.g., Retail, Tech, Healthcare), customer tenure, segment, and product configuration to reduce the team's operational load.

  • Performance Analysis: Regularly analyze and report on what is working to gain customer buy-in for communication programs, tying results directly to business impact and customer health outcomes.

  • Team Resilience & Well-being: Maintain sustainable workloads, protect the team's strategic thinking space, and manage day-to-day operational friction in alignment with our "Mind Yourself" value.

  • Exceptional ability to translate complex data and metrics into compelling strategic insights for both internal executives and external client benefits leaders.

  • Proven experience working cross-functionally to navigate complex initiatives, manage tight timelines, and handle client account escalations.

  • A self-starter who works well independently, managing teams and objectives proactively without hand-holding.

  • Deep empathy for customer needs, a background in healthcare or employee benefits (highly preferred), and a genuine passion for mental health.

  • Familiarity with JIRA, Salesforce, Tableau, Highspot, and/or Confluence is a plus.

    About the Role: 

    The Director of People Analytics and Workforce Intelligence will lead our global workforce intelligence strategy, transforming complex talent and organizational data into actionable business outcomes. Reporting to the Sr. Director, People Solutions, you will bridge HR, Artificial Intelligence, and enterprise analytics. 

    We are seeking a visionary leader to architect scalable solutions that empower executive leadership and managers to make data-driven decisions. You will build proactive tools to create insights that shift the paradigm from reactive reporting to predictive talent interventions.

    This role can be based in our Madison, WI office, or fully remote/virtual. Remote candidates must be physically located within the United States.

    ","id":"49ae8dac-eb7b-48b5-8611-ef6ec167c335","lists":[{"text":"Responsibilities","content":"

  • Define and execute the global roadmap for People Analytics, aligning workforce insights directly with core business strategy and growth goals.

    About Lyra Health
    Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.

    About The Role

    We are seeking an experienced Director, Provider Performance & Analytics to build and oversee the measurement architecture for provider performance across all clinical service lines. In this role, you will define how Lyra measures provider capacity, availability, schedule utilization, productivity, and quality across a diverse clinical workforce spanning therapy, coaching, medication management, high-acuity care, substance use treatment, and neuropsychology.

    Operating at the intersection of Clinical Leadership, Operations, Data Analytics, Finance, and Product, you will establish common performance definitions, build scalable measurement frameworks and executive dashboards, diagnose systemic performance variation, and translate data insights into operational management systems.

    The ideal candidate brings strong healthcare analytics and performance expertise—combining hands-on quantitative data fluency and systems thinking with proven operational judgment in a complex healthcare environment.

    ","id":"1fc1bb17-b865-4fb3-ac0a-7053569d2d59","lists":[{"text":"What You’ll Do:","content":"

  • Performance Architecture & Vision: Define the multi-year roadmap for provider performance measurement and management across therapy, coaching, medication management, high-acuity care, substance use treatment, neuropsychology, and future service lines. Establish a unified performance architecture that appropriately accounts for differences in clinical disciplines, care modalities, and patient populations.

  • Metric Logic & Data Governance: Partner with Clinical, Analytics, Finance, and Operations leaders to define the exact metrics and methodologies for provider supply, availability, active panel capacity, schedule utilization, productivity, and access. Establish standardized metric definitions, governance, and single sources of truth across the enterprise.

  • Analytics, Dashboards & Decision Support: Translate performance strategy into actionable dashboards, scorecards, forecasting capabilities, and decision-support tools. Ensure data is tailored for action across all levels—from frontline providers and clinical managers to service-line and C-suite leadership.

  • Systemic Diagnosis & Capacity Oversight: Develop scalable approaches to model provider capacity across employment models (W2 vs. 1099), clinical specialties, and care modalities. Partner with service-line leaders to establish appropriate productivity expectations and identify the operational drivers of provider availability and utilization.

  • Ownership of Provider Reviews & Escalations: Establish mechanisms for provider goal setting, performance reviews, and escalations. Partner closely with Clinical Leadership and People teams on appropriate ownership of individual provider performance.

  • Executive Reporting & Business Reviews: Develop executive-level reporting and recurring business-review mechanisms (WBRs/QBRs) that clearly communicate network trends, variations, risks, and opportunities, helping senior leaders translate insights into organizational priorities and investment decisions.

  • Team Scaling & Cross-Functional Leadership: Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing operations and analytics team, and serve as a trusted partner to senior leaders across Clinical, Operations, Analytics, Finance, Product, and People to build alignment.

  • 5+ Years of Direct People Management: Demonstrated track record of scaling high-performing analytics or operations teams and fostering a culture of disciplined problem-solving.

  • Strategic Clinical & Executive Partnership: Proven track record of collaborating effectively with non-technical executive stakeholders—especially clinical or medical leaders—to build buy-in, translate complex data, and establish shared operational goals.

    About the Role:
     
    As a Clinical Care Navigator on the Organizational Services Team, you’ll be doing meaningful, high-impact work supporting companies and their employees through moments of challenge, change, and crisis. You’ll be the first clinical point of contact for HR, ER, and Benefits teams reaching out for expert guidance, and you’ll coordinate thoughtful, timely support for employees navigating behavioral health concerns. You won’t be providing ongoing therapy, you’ll use your clinical skills to offer expert consultation, coordinate critical incident responses, and proactively reach out to employees in crisis. Your work will help ensure safety and connection to high-quality care.

    This role may be for you if you’re an excellent communicator, confident in your clinical judgment, and passionate about making behavioral health more accessible in the workplace. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, can shift seamlessly between support calls and consultation, and have a strong sense of professional presence when working with VIPs and organizational leaders. If you’re someone who finds purpose in showing up for people at pivotal moments and helping them get to the right care at the right time, this role could be a great fit.

    You must be able to work one of the following shift(s):
    Tuesday - Saturday 1:00 PM - 9:30 PM PST / 2:00 PM - 10:30 PM MST: / 3:00 PM - 11:30 PM CST: / 4:00 PM - 12:30 AM EST
    Sunday - Thursday 1:00 PM - 9:30 PM PST / 2:00 PM - 10:30 PM MST: / 3:00 PM - 11:30 PM CST: / 4:00 PM - 12:30 AM EST

    About the Role: 

    As our Engagement Marketing Lead, you will play a key role in scaling member registration and engagement across Lyra Health's full book of business. Building the operating models, playbooks, and scaled marketing solutions that make it possible to deliver high-quality engagement to every customer without requiring 1:1 customization. We're looking for a builder and systems thinker who can translate what works with individual customers into repeatable marketing programming and processes that reach many customers efficiently, and who is comfortable partnering across Customer Marketing, Customer Success, Strategy & Operations, and Analytics to make that happen.

    This role is ideal for someone who thinks in systems and repeatable models rather than one-off solutions — a marketer who wants their impact to be felt across hundreds of customers rather than a handful.

    ","id":"87026dd3-68d6-4ad7-9857-5f13d9f6294a","lists":[{"text":"Responsibilities","content":"
  • Build and Maintain Scaled Marketing Operating Models: Design and own repeatable operating models and marketing frameworks that enable high-quality engagement programs to be delivered consistently across commercial and large  customers.
  • Develop Member Engagement Playbooks: Create standardized engagement playbooks and B2B2C marketing strategies tied to size of customer, industry, tenure, and product configuration  that Customer Marketing Managers and Customer Success teams can deploy without building from scratch each time.
  • Drive Registration and Utilization at Scale: Partner with Member Marketing, CS, Workforce Transformation, Creative, Operations, and Analytics teams to build automated, trigger-based communication programs that lift member registration and utilization across the full customer base.
  • Standardize Assets and Toolkits: Oversee the development of a library of customizable, on-brand marketing assets and toolkits, partnering closely with Creative Design and Content teams.
  • Measurement and Continuous Improvement: Work with analytics to design tracking methodology, and reporting to evaluate the performance of scaled programs, using data to identify what to test, refine, retire, or expand.
  • Process and Systems Ownership: Own and evolve the marketing templates, tools, workflows, and systems that allow engagement marketing to operate efficiently at scale as the customer base grows.

  • Data-Driven: Analytical mindset with experience using data to evaluate program performance across many accounts simultaneously and translate insights into scaled marketing recommendations and high performance.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Proven track record of working effectively across Marketing, Customer Success, Operations, and Analytics teams to build and ship solutions. .
  • Communication Skills: Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to bring diverse stakeholders along as you evolve ways of working and customer marketing activities..
  • Project Management: Strong organizational skills and demonstrated success managing multiple concurrent initiatives.
  • Technical Tools: Familiarity with Salesforce, Gainsight, Highspot, and/or Jira required.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable operating with a good deal of latitude, exercising judgment in selecting the right methods and techniques as priorities evolve.

    To provide high-quality professional counselling, "in-the-moment" support, and intake services.
    Serves as the central point for clinical triage and scheduling for Lyra service users.
    Core Responsibilities:
    Helpline & Crisis Management

    Serve as the primary first point of contact for employees and their dependents accessing the Lyra helpline via telephone, live chat, or email.
    Provide immediate "in-the-moment" clinical support to callers in distress, utilizing psychological first aid and stabilization techniques.
    Conduct comprehensive clinical risk assessments for every contact to identify potential self-harm, ideation, or risk to others, adhering strictly to Lyra’s risk protocols.
    Manage emergency interventions and coordinate with local emergency services or internal senior clinical leads when high-risk situations are identified.
    2. Clinical Intake & Triage

    Conduct detailed clinical intake interviews to assess the user’s presenting concerns, history, and level of psychological distress.
    Evaluate the appropriateness of short-term counseling versus higher-acuity care pathways based on the clinical assessment.
    Utilize internal decision-making frameworks to assign clients to the most suitable professional within the in-house team or partner network, matching based on specialty and language preference.
    Accurately evaluate clinical needs to evaluate whether care should be provided within a structured, short-term framework.
    3. Delivery of Clinical Sessions

    Provide high-quality, professional counseling and psychotherapy sessions to clients within a structured, short-term framework.
    Utilize evidence-based interventions (such as CBT or solution-focused therapy) to address client queries and specific mental health concerns.
    Ensure all clinical sessions are workplace-focused when appropriate, helping the service user improve their level of functioning and productivity.
    Maintain accurate, contemporaneous clinical notes for every session, meeting the legal and professional standards of the Indian healthcare landscape.
    Monitor client progress through regular outcome measurement and adjust treatment plans or escalate to the Senior CCM for complex review as necessary.
    4. Advanced Scheduling & Appointment Coordination

    Systematically manage the daily clinical roster, ensuring optimal coverage across all shifts to meet real-time helpline demand.
    Coordinate and maintain the master calendar for all in-house counseling and coaching appointments, minimizing gaps and preventing double bookings.
    Act as the primary coordinator for booking, rescheduling, and managing cancellations, ensuring both service users and clinicians are updated in real-time.
    Monitor clinician availability and specialized skill sets to ensure clients are scheduled with the most appropriate professional.
    5. Precision Data Capture & Database Stewardship

    Accurately capture and input all vital clinical information—including demographics, presenting concerns, and risk status—into the database at the point of entry.
    Ensure all data points required for case management (such as CORE-10 scores, session counts, and work impact metrics) are logged with high precision.
    Maintain database integrity by ensuring all case statuses and appointment outcomes are updated immediately following service delivery.
    Handle all sensitive clinical data with the highest level of confidentiality, adhering to global data protection standards and local regulations.
    6. Operational Liaison & Cross-Functional Coordination

    Serve as the central point of contact to coordinate daily activities between clinical and operations teams to facilitate a seamless user experience.
    Manage the transition of cases between teams, ensuring all clinical and operational context is successfully communicated to the receiving professional.
    Act as a liaison to resolve logistical or operational bottlenecks between departments to ensure administrative hurdles do not impact care.
    Regularly communicate operational updates and capacity shifts to leadership to ensure the strategic vision is executed daily.
    7. Miscellaneous & Continuous Improvement

    Upholding Lyra Values: Act as a brand ambassador by consistently demonstrating Lyra’s core values of clinical excellence, innovation, and empathy.
    Task Ownership: Ensure all allotted clinical and administrative tasks are performed with high precision and within agreed-upon Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
    Process Optimization: Proactively identify gaps in current workflows and take the initiative to propose solutions that enhance operational efficiency.
    Workshops & Content: Participate in opportunities to deliver onsite or online workshops and contribute to the development of clinical content and training manuals.
    Event Participation: Represent Lyra Health at professional events and webinars to promote the transformative care model and clinical research.

    About Lyra

    Lyra Health is the leading provider of mental health solutions for employers supporting more than 20 million people globally. The company has delivered 13 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 20 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.

    The Junior Clinical Case Manager (Jr. CCM) operates as a vital link between direct clinical care and operational oversight within Lyra Health’s mental health delivery model in India. This permanent position encompasses first-line helpline and crisis management, clinical intake triage, and the delivery of structured, workplace-focused short-term therapy. Beyond direct care, the role drives quality assurance and operational compliance by auditing clinical documentation, monitoring outcome metrics such as CORE-10, preventing clinical drift, and managing affiliate network relationships and onboarding. Requiring a Master’s degree in Clinical or Counseling Psychology, three to six years of progressive clinical experience—preferably in EAP or corporate mental health environments—and fluency in English and Hindi, the Jr. CCM blends high-level clinical risk assessment with detail-oriented case management to ensure high quality, scalable care across the provider network.
    ","id":"d46f0095-045d-4d2a-8bb0-e75664eeb590","lists":[{"text":"Purpose of the Job: ","content":"

    To manage clinical operations, facilitate referrals, and monitor the quality of care delivered by the provider network.
    It is a permanent position focused on operationalizing high-quality clinical care.


    Working Hours: 48 hours per week.
    Schedule: 5 or 6 days a week; various shifts may be applicable.
    Hybrid Work: Hybrid working can be considered as per the need of the job.

    "},{"text":"Responsibilities: ","content":"

    1. Helpline & Crisis Management
    Serve as the primary first point of contact for employees and their dependents accessing the Lyra helpline via telephone, live chat, or email.
    Provide immediate "in-the-moment" clinical support to callers in distress, utilizing psychological first aid and stabilization techniques.
    Conduct comprehensive clinical risk assessments for every contact to identify potential self-harm, ideation, or risk to others, adhering to Lyra’s established risk protocols.
    Manage emergency interventions and coordinate with local emergency services or internal senior clinical leads when high-risk situations are identified.

    2. Clinical Intake & Triage
    Conduct detailed clinical intake interviews to assess the user’s presenting concerns, history, and level of psychological distress.
    Evaluate the appropriateness of short-term counseling versus higher-acuity care pathways based on the clinical assessment.
    Utilize internal decision-making frameworks to assign clients to the most suitable professional within the in-house team or the partner provider network, matching based on clinical specialty and language preference.
    Accurately capture and document all clinical intake data, including CORE-10 scores and work impact metrics, in the database to ensure a seamless handover to the treating clinician.

    3. Delivery of Clinical Sessions
    Provide high-quality, professional counseling and psychotherapy sessions to clients within a structured, short-term framework.
    Utilize evidence-based interventions (such as CBT or solution-focused therapy) to address client queries and specific mental health concerns.
    Ensure all clinical sessions are workplace-focused when appropriate, helping the service user improve their level of functioning and productivity.
    Maintain accurate, contemporaneous clinical notes for every session, ensuring they meet the legal and professional standards of the Indian healthcare landscape.
    Monitor client progress through regular outcome measurement and adjust the treatment plan as necessary, or escalate to the Senior CCM for complex case review.

    4. Documentation Oversight & Quality Assurance
    Conduct systematic monitoring of all active clinical cases from initiation to closure to ensure strict adherence to Lyra’s clinical documentation standards.
    Proactively follow up with internal clinicians and affiliate providers to secure missing or delayed clinical notes, treatment plans, and discharge summaries.
    Audit case files for the accurate inclusion of outcome measurements, specifically tracking the consistent use of CORE-10 and work impact scores.
    Ensure all clinical documentation is captured within the database in a timely manner, maintaining a high standard of data integrity for audit readiness.
    Identify and escalate recurring documentation gaps to the Senior CCM to facilitate targeted provider training and performance management.

    5. Affiliate Network & Specialty Support
    Serve as the primary point of operational contact for the partner provider network, offering continuous support regarding administrative and portal requirements.
    Maintain and verify the accuracy of the affiliate database, ensuring all partner providers have professional, updated bios that reflect their current clinical expertise.
    Routinely audit and update provider specialties and language proficiencies to ensure the intake team can perform precise referral matching.
    Assist in the onboarding process by training new affiliates on Lyra’s specific clinical protocols, risk management procedures, and case referral workflows.
    Support partner providers in navigating cross-border referral processes and understanding local compliance nuances.

    6. Protocol Adherence
    Intervention Alignment: Rigorously audit treatment plans to ensure all clinical interventions align with Lyra’s evidence-based, short-term, and solution-focused models.
    Workplace Focus Integration: Evaluate clinical goals to ensure they are specifically designed to improve the service user’s level of functioning within the workplace, focusing on "Work Impact" and productivity restoration.
    Goal-Oriented Care: Verify that every treatment plan includes clear, measurable objectives that can be reasonably achieved within the prescribed short-term session limit.
    Clinical Gatekeeping: Identify and address "clinical drift" where therapy may be deviating from the brief intervention framework or losing its workplace-centric focus.
    Standardized Assessment Review: Monitor the consistent application of clinical outcome measures (such as CORE-10) to validate that the intervention protocol is resulting in measurable symptom reduction.
    Provider Consultation: Provide direct feedback and consultation to partner providers when treatment plans do not meet Lyra’s specific clinical protocols or service level agreements.
    Case Escalation: Manage the transition of cases that require longer-term or higher-acuity care, ensuring the handover remains compliant with Lyra’s global clinical standards and local professional guidelines.

    7. Miscellaneous
    Upholding Lyra Values: Act as a brand ambassador by consistently demonstrating Lyra’s core values of clinical excellence, innovation, and empathy in every interaction with colleagues, providers, and service users.
    Task Ownership & Accountability: Ensure all allotted clinical and administrative tasks are performed with high precision and within agreed-upon Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
    Process Optimization Initiatives: Proactively identify gaps in current workflows and take the initiative to propose and implement solutions that enhance operational efficiency and clinical outcomes.
    Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate seamlessly with the Clinical Lead, Client Success, and Product teams to ensure the delivery of the highest quality care to both clients (companies) and individual customers.
    Workshop Delivery & Training: Participate in opportunities to deliver onsite or online workshops and training sessions for client organizations as requested.
    Content Creation: Contribute to the development of clinical content, training manuals, and affiliate-facing materials to maintain Lyra’s position as a thought leader in mental health.

    Event Participation: Represent Lyra Health at professional events, webinars, and industry conferences to promote Lyra’s transformative care model and clinical research.

    About the Role: 

    The Lead Compensation Analyst manages core global compensation processes and serves as an advisor to HR and business leaders. Reporting to the Director, Global Compensation, this lead individual contributor role blends data modeling with business consultation to keep our pay practices competitive, fair, and compliant across all operational regions.

    In this role, you will lead the annual global compensation cycle, administer short- and long-term incentive programs, manage job leveling and market benchmarking, and run key total rewards initiatives.     ","id":"6d6d2fae-49c1-4179-95e0-dccc52178763","lists":[{"text":"Responsibilities","content":"

    1. Compensation Consultation & Business Partnership

  • Act as the primary compensation advisor for HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, and business leaders—providing guidance on candidate offers, promotions, market adjustments, job evaluation and leveling, and other elements of compensation.

  • Partner with leaders to explain market trends, pay practices, and policy application across different regions.

  • Work cross-functionally with Sales Operations and Finance on shared compensation initiatives to ensure operational alignment, accurate budgeting, and proper plan governance.

    • 2. Job Evaluation, Incentive Design & Market Benchmarking

  • Evaluate and market-price new and evolving roles to recommend job levels, salary bands, and job family placements.

  • Lead benchmarking projects using survey data to evaluate market competitiveness and recommend updates to pay structures.

  • Maintain the global job catalog and architecture, suggesting updates to leveling guidelines and benchmarking standards as the organization grows.

  • Support the analysis, evaluation, and administration of short-term (bonus) and long-term (equity/LTI) incentive programs to ensure they align with business objectives and drive performance.

    • 3. Annual Compensation Cycle Administration

  • Lead the end-to-end planning and execution of the global annual compensation review cycle (merit, promotions, equity allocations, and short-term incentives)—including eligibility audits, budget analysis, Workday testing, payout calculations, and post-cycle audits.

  • Model merit budgets, incentive payout forecasts, and cost scenarios for HR and Finance leadership, while tracking cycle timelines, approval workflows, and policy exceptions.

  • Partner with Communications and Talent Development to create and deliver clear manager guidelines, timelines, and training resources for a smooth cycle.

    • 4. Data Analysis, Reporting & Process Improvement

  • Analyze internal pay data to conduct pay equity reviews, run cost scenarios, and evaluate market positioning.

  • Turn complex datasets into clear summaries, dashboards, and executive presentations to support decision-making.

  • Serve as the functional expert for compensation systems; partner with HRIS on Workday updates, configuration testing, data integrity, and process improvements.

  • Identify opportunities to leverage modern AI tools and technology to automate manual reporting, streamline data workflows, and improve operational efficiency across compensation operations.

    • 5. Training, Compliance & Project Management

  • Build and deliver compensation training materials to help managers and employees understand pay structures, our compensation philosophy, and how to navigate compensation conversations.

  • Maintain active oversight of wage and hour regulations, local and global pay transparency laws, and labor compliance regulations across operating regions.

  • Manage projects independently.

    Education & Experience Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).

  • Compensation Experience: 7+ years of progressive compensation experience with strong hands-on background in program administration, job evaluation, short-term incentives, and market benchmarking across multi-region or global operations (e.g., Americas, EMEA, APAC).

  • HRIS Skills: Direct experience with Workday (both Core Compensation and Advanced Compensation modules required).

  • Analytical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, with a proven ability to model, audit, and analyze complex datasets.

  • Benchmarking Platforms: Hands-on experience using market pricing platforms and global salary survey data.

  • Communication & Influence: Strong consultative and presentation skills, with a track record of building trust with leaders, explaining pay concepts clearly to non-HR audiences, and partnering effectively with HR and Finance teams.

    • Knowledge, Skills & Competencies

  • Deep understanding of job evaluation methodologies, market pricing, salary structures, incentive plan mechanics (STI/LTI), and annual review cycles.

  • Strong working knowledge of compensation compliance regulations, including FLSA, global pay transparency legislation, and international pay practices.

  • Ability to run projects independently with minimal oversight, handle complex pay scenarios with sound judgment, and maintain strict confidentiality.

  • Demonstrated interest or experience in using AI tools and technology solutions to optimize workflows, automate routine compensation analysis, and increase operational productivity.

  • Certified Compensation Professional (CCP) preferred

    ","categories":{"commitment":"Full-time","department":"LCA","location":"United States","team":"Lyra Dialectical Behavioral Therapy","allLocations":["United States"]},"createdAt":1755502997288,"descriptionPlain":"About Lyra   Lyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Lyra members have access to care in one day, and nine out of ten improve with the support of providers like you. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. You will be employed by Lyra Clinical Associates. About the Role Lyra developed an innovative video therapy program called Lyra Care Therapy: Blending live video sessions with between-session digital psychoeducation and customizable skill building tools. The Lyra Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT) program capitalizes on Lyra Care Therapy to supplement standard individual DBT and DBT skills groups with novel between-session DBT-relevant digital activities—activities that help promote skill generalization and integration into your clients’ daily lives. Lyra DBT clients also have 24/7 access to a team of licensed clinicians who have been trained in DBT skills coaching for around the clock support.    Daily: As a Lyra DBT Therapist, you’ll provide individual DBT and DBT skills groups via live video to adult clients. You’ll also assign DBT-relevant digital lessons, videos, and assessments to your clients to enhance learnings and monitor outcomes between sessions. An important note: Lyra's clients come from a multitude of backgrounds and experiences, and have varying needs and abilities. We strive to continue to meet their unique needs by delivering culturally responsive care—an approach that accounts for the impact of cultural backgrounds on each person’s care experience.   Regularly: Our therapists enjoy connecting with their colleagues who share a passion for providing evidence-based care. You’ll attend weekly consultation team meetings as well as one-on-one consultation meetings with an expert DBT team lead, co-lead DBT skills groups with other DBT providers, and attend robust trainings to enhance your clinical skills.
