    About Lyra Health
    Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.

    About the Role

    We are seeking a Staff ML/AI Engineer to define and drive the architectural vision for Lyra’s machine learning and generative AI technology landscape. In this role, you will serve as a technical anchor across the engineering and data organizations—architecting enterprise-scale AI platforms, setting technical strategy for high-impact AI/ML initiatives, and ensuring our AI products operate with top-tier reliability, security, and medical precision.

    The ideal candidate is a seasoned technical leader who excels at translating complex healthcare challenges into scalable platform solutions, building consensus across cross-functional leadership, and elevating the technical bar for the entire engineering organization.

    Lyra is for you if you

    • Thrive on working with brilliant teammates to solve complex, meaningful problems

    • Are passionate about making a social impact and supporting people at their most challenging moments

    • Enjoy cross-functional collaboration with physicians, therapists, data scientists, data analysts and product managers

    ","id":"d4806b14-3818-4aca-af97-96bb88dd0b4c","lists":[{"text":"Responsibilities","content":"

  • Drive AI Platform Architecture: Design and execute the long-term roadmap for Lyra’s machine learning and generative AI platform, enabling fast, safe, and reliable deployment of frontier models across the company.

  • Lead AI Infrastructure Vision: Architect end-to-end training, fine-tuning, and low-latency inference platforms, including centralized RAG architecture, vector databases, and enterprise evaluation/guardrail frameworks.

  • Set Engineering Excellence Standards: Establish organizational standards for the full AI/ML SDLC—from dataset lineage and CI/CD pipelines to automated model evaluation, red-teaming, and production monitoring.

  • Cross-Functional Technical Leadership: Partner closely with Product Management, Data Science, Security, and Clinical leaders to translate strategic clinical goals into foundational AI capability roadmaps.

  • Mentor and Multiply Impact: Elevate the engineering culture by mentoring Senior ML Engineers, conducting high-leverage architectural reviews, and establishing engineering best practices across teams.

  • Hands-On Leadership: Lead by example through technical prototypes, critical-path architecture, and strategic coding contributions.

  • And of course, you will be coding!

    • "},{"text":"Qualifications","content":"

  • 8+ years of experience deploying complex ML/AI solutions into mission-critical production environments, with a proven track record of technical leadership.

    About Lyra
     
    Lyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. You will be contracted by Lyra Clinical Associates.

    About the Role
     

    Lyra is committed to addressing urgent and costly mental health needs with specialized support where it’s needed most. Our Center of Excellence for Neurodiversity offers neuropsychological and psychological assessments, diagnosis, and tailored care for ADHD, and support for autism and learning differences. We are looking for contract Testing Psychologists who are passionate about whole-person, whole-family mental health care. 

    The Testing Psychologist will perform comprehensive intake interviews and psychological assessments to support diagnostic clarity, treatment planning, and intervention strategies for children, adolescents, and adults. This role focuses on addressing behavioral health complexities, providing actionable insights through psychoeducational and psychological evaluations, and collaborating with interdisciplinary care teams to optimize outcomes.

    This role is a great fit for providers who are results driven, detailed, process oriented, and comfortable with data. Candidates with an independent work ethic who are flexible and adaptable, we encourage you to apply. 

    ","id":"512aaf33-307d-4218-a624-311fe06bb2dc","lists":[{"text":"Key responsibilities:","content":"

  • Work with patients of all ages is preferred, as well as their families, by providing intake interviews and psychological evaluations

  • Administer, interpret, and integrate a wide variety of psychological test batteries, focusing on cognitive, emotional, behavioral, and academic functioning

  • Provide clear, evidence-based diagnostic impressions and actionable recommendations tailored to the individual’s needs

  • Collaborate and review work with psychometrists and psychometrist assistants, overseeing test administration, scoring, and ensuring quality control

  • Deliver compassionate feedback through feedback videos and live sessions to communicate findings and recommendations

  • Maintain a detail-oriented, process-focused approach to ensure the accuracy of testing data and comprehensive reporting

  • Utilize telehealth platforms effectively for remote assessments, including adapting testing strategies for virtual delivery

  • Conduct intake interviews, testing sessions, and live feedback sessions, delivered virtually or in person, as indicated

    • "},{"text":"Requirements:","content":"

  • Doctorate degree in Psychology (PhD or PsyD) from an American Psychological Association or Canadian Psychological Association accredited program

  • Licensed Clinical Psychologist in at least one state

  • PSYPACT authorized or PSYPACT eligible preferred

  • 3+ years of experience in psychological assessments with children, adolescents, or adults

  • Familiarity with evaluating complex behavioral health needs (e.g., ASD, ADHD, mood disorders, anxiety, trauma)

  • Expertise in psychological and psychoeducational assessment tools (e.g., BASC, Conners, WAIS, WISC)

  • Effective therapeutic communication skills

  • Proficiency with telehealth platforms and remote testing tools

  • Experience conducting testing virtually

  • Ability to deliver  care virtually or in person and within your own office space

  • Candidates must successfully pass a background check for this opportunit

  • Testing supplies are provided for you

    About the Role
     

    Lyra is committed to addressing urgent and costly mental health needs with specialized support where it’s needed most. Our Center of Excellence for Neurodiversity offers neuropsychological and psychological assessments, diagnosis, and tailored care for ADHD, and support for autism and learning differences. We are looking for contract Testing Psychologists who are passionate about whole-person, whole-family mental health care. 

    The Testing Psychologist will perform comprehensive intake interviews and psychological assessments to support diagnostic clarity, treatment planning, and intervention strategies for children, adolescents, and adults. This role focuses on addressing behavioral health complexities, providing actionable insights through psychoeducational and psychological evaluations, and collaborating with interdisciplinary care teams to optimize outcomes.

    This role is a great fit for providers who are results driven, detailed, process oriented, and comfortable with data. Candidates with an independent work ethic who are flexible and adaptable, we encourage you to apply. 

    ","id":"022c7db7-686e-4327-8c1c-61ae8045bdf3","lists":[{"text":"Key responsibilities:","content":"

  • Work with patients of all ages is preferred, as well as their families, by providing intake interviews and psychological evaluations

  • Administer, interpret, and integrate a wide variety of psychological test batteries, focusing on cognitive, emotional, behavioral, and academic functioning

  • Provide clear, evidence-based diagnostic impressions and actionable recommendations tailored to the individual’s needs

  • Collaborate and review work with psychometrists and psychometrist assistants, overseeing test administration, scoring, and ensuring quality control

  • Deliver compassionate feedback through feedback videos and live sessions to communicate findings and recommendations

  • Maintain a detail-oriented, process-focused approach to ensure the accuracy of testing data and comprehensive reporting

  • Utilize telehealth platforms effectively for remote assessments, including adapting testing strategies for virtual delivery

  • Conduct intake interviews, testing sessions, and live feedback sessions, delivered virtually or in person, as indicated

    • "},{"text":"Requirements:","content":"

  • Doctorate degree in Psychology (PhD or PsyD) from an American Psychological Association or Canadian Psychological Association accredited program

  • Licensed Clinical Psychologist in at least one state

  • PSYPACT authorized or PSYPACT eligible preferred

  • 3+ years of experience in psychological assessments with children, adolescents, or adults

  • Familiarity with evaluating complex behavioral health needs (e.g., ASD, ADHD, mood disorders, anxiety, trauma)

  • Expertise in psychological and psychoeducational assessment tools (e.g., BASC, Conners, WAIS, WISC)

  • Effective therapeutic communication skills

  • Proficiency with telehealth platforms and remote testing tools

  • Experience conducting testing virtually

  • Ability to deliver  care virtually or in person and within your own office space

  • Candidates must successfully pass a background check for this opportunit

  • Access to a robust offering of live and recorded CE credited courses (approved by APA, ASWB, and NBCC) 
  • Access to cutting edge technology and a team of support staff (e.g., psychometrists, psychometrist assistants) to help ease the administrative burden of the evaluation process
  • Testing supplies are provided for you

The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Lyra members have access to care in one day, and nine out of ten improve with the support of providers like you. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. You will be contracted by Lyra Clinical Associates.

    Note for providers: If you have a client who has access to Lyra and is interested in having their sessions covered through their employer benefit with us, please review the opportunity below to determine if you meet the requirements. Once confirmed, we encourage you to submit your application via the apply link at the bottom of the page.

    By joining Lyra's network, not only would you be able to provide ongoing care for your client, but also have the opportunity to connect with other Lyra members for care.

    About the Opportunity

    Lyra’s provider network is composed of in-person and virtual therapists, physicians, and coaches across the US. With our advanced matching technology, supportive provider platform, and opportunities for training and clinical consultation, being part of our network is an incredible chance to do what you love (like patient care) with support for the things you don’t love (like self promotion and scheduling).

    We are looking for contract nurse practitioners (NPs) or certified physician assistants (PA-C) who are passionate about whole-person, whole family mental health care and working within a connected network to provide patients with easily accessible, culturally responsive, high-quality mental health care. 

    As a contract provider, you’ll provide evidence-based treatment via intake appointments and regular follow-up appointments. You'll conduct psychiatric evaluations and provide medication management. Lyra makes it easy to refer patients to therapy and coaching services in tandem with your care.

    You will provide care to individuals from a multitude of different backgrounds and experiences, as well as those with varying needs and abilities. We strive to continue to meet their unique needs by delivering culturally-responsive care—an approach that is mindful of the impact of cultural background on each person’s care experience.

    We’re currently prioritizing hiring in Delaware, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania.

    About Lyra Health
    Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.

    About the Role: 

    Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Global Controller, the Vice President, Global Accounting will lead an organization of approximately 16 professionals spanning accounting operations, consolidated financial reporting, and treasury.

    This is a highly visible leadership role, and as Lyra continues to grow and evolve, this leader will be responsible for scaling the accounting function and building the processes, controls, systems, talent, and operating discipline necessary to support increasing business complexity and prepare the company to operate at public-company standards.

    The ideal candidate is a modern accounting executive who combines deep accounting expertise with exceptional operational leadership, strategic thinking, and a transformation mindset. They have successfully led and scaled accounting organizations in complex, high-growth environments and understand what it takes to build a world-class, public-company-ready accounting function.

    This leader will be equally comfortable setting strategy, developing talent, challenging existing processes, leveraging technology and AI, and engaging directly in complex accounting matters when needed. They will serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and a key architect of Lyra’s next-generation accounting organization.

    ","id":"fa62dc18-6e38-4a6e-aed9-9f6cfddc0220","lists":[{"text":"Responsibilities","content":"

    Corporate Accounting & Financial Reporting

  • Provide leadership and oversight across corporate accounting, general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, lease accounting, consolidations, and related accounting operations.

  • Lead consolidated financial reporting ensuring timely and accurate financial results in accordance with U.S. GAAP .

  • Establish and maintain accounting policies, governance, and processes and lead the evaluation and implementation of new accounting standards.

  • Deliver meaningful financial information and insights to support executive decision-making.

    • Public Company & SOX Readiness

  • Support the design and implementation of a scalable SOX compliance framework, including strong business-process controls, governance, documentation, and accountability.

  • Strengthen the accounting organization’s infrastructure across close and consolidation, SEC-quality financial reporting, accounting policies, technical accounting, internal controls, systems, documentation, and audit readiness.

    • Accounting Operations & Transformation

  • Lead the standardization and optimization of accounting processes globally, establishing clear ownership, performance expectations, service levels, and measurable outcomes.

  • Champion continuous improvement and identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, simplify processes, accelerate cycle times, and improve the quality and accessibility of financial information.

  • Bring a technology-forward mindset to Accounting, identifying opportunities to leverage automation, AI, standardized workflows, and modern financial systems to improve speed, accuracy, scalability, controls, and insight.

    • Treasury & Cash Management

  • Strengthen processes supporting cash visibility, liquidity management, cash positioning, and working capital optimization.

  • Develop recommendations that support effective capital deployment, liquidity management, and financial risk management.

    • Leadership & Business Partnership

  • Lead, develop, and scale a high-performing accounting organization building organizational depth, leadership capability, accountability, and opportunities for professional growth.

  • Create an environment that attracts, develops, engages, and retains exceptional accounting talent.

  • Build strong partnerships to drive alignment and successfully execute cross-functional initiatives.

    • What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role will mean building upon Lyra’s accounting foundation and transforming the organization for its next stage of growth. This leader will help create:

  • A scalable, high-performing global accounting organization with strong leadership depth and clear accountability.

  • A faster, more predictable, and increasingly automated financial close.

  • Standardized global accounting processes supported by strong systems, data, and controls.

  • Financial reporting and accounting infrastructure capable of operating at public-company standards.

  • A robust and sustainable SOX and internal-control environment.

  • Greater use of technology, automation, and AI across accounting workflows.

  • An accounting organization recognized as a trusted, strategic partner to the business.

    • "},{"text":"Qualifications","content":"

  • Strong executive presence and communication skills, with demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, navigate complex issues, resolve escalations, and drive alignment across functions.

  • 15+ years of progressive accounting experience with demonstrated success leading and developing complex accounting organizations in a global environment.

  • Public-company accounting experience; a deep understanding of U.S. GAAP and SEC reporting requirements, SOX and audit requirements.

  • Demonstrated success leading accounting transformation, process standardization, automation, and continuous-improvement initiatives.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA required.

  • A collaborative, pragmatic leadership style and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, high-growth environment.

    As a full-time Vice President, Global Accounting, you will be employed by Lyra Health, Inc. The anticipated annual base salary range for this full-time position is $213,030 to $286,670. The base range is determined by role and level, and placement within the range will depend on a number of job-related factors, including but not limited to your skills, qualifications, experience and location.     About Lyra
     

    Lyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Lyra members have access to care in one day, and nine out of ten improve with the support of providers like you. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. You will be employed by Lyra Clinical Associates.


    About the Role

    We are looking for an experienced mental health clinical leader with a passion for clinical quality and management to serve as a clinical quality manager and lead for our Pediatric virtual Intensive Outpatient Program (vIOP), an accelerated, comprehensive care experience that helps young people ages 7 to 25 feel better quickly from the comfort of home. The pediatric vIOP is a critical service for acute patients who need more than traditional, once-a-week therapy. This program is a critical component of our full-spectrum of care services. It not only helps to avoid re-hospitalization, but its availability within our services ensures these members have direct access to our core coaching, therapy, and psychiatry services once they are stabilized. 

    For this full-time role, the primary responsibility will be to train, provide management oversight, and clinical consultation to a team of behavioral care managers and therapists practicing CBT, DBT, ERP and other evidence-based practices to vIOP clients through our innovative video therapy platform. This includes reviewing and providing feedback on clinical quality metrics and consulting on clinical cases. You will also assist with key quality improvement initiatives including specialty consultations, provider training, and quality assurance reviews. 

    This role is a great fit if you have training, experience, and expertise in treating clients (young adults and adolescents) with mood and anxiety disorders in an intensive outpatient program setting, as well as a commitment to evidence-based and culturally responsive care, clinical quality assurance, experience in administrative and clinical management of licensed independent mental health providers and case managers, and developing high performing teams. 

    This role reports to our Sr. Director, High Acuity Care Service.

  • Provide ongoing feedback regarding team member’s’ performance including clinical quality, productivity, adherence to evidence-based treatment models, client feedback, and interpersonal effectiveness

  • Lead ongoing 1:1’s and consultation team meeting with assigned vIOP therapists, behavioral care managers, and consultation teams

  • PhD or PSYD in clinical or counseling psychology or Master’s degree from a clinical track (e.g., MSW, MFT, MC, MMHC) from an accredited program

  • Current unrestricted license to practice within the United States

  • Experienced and passionate about helping kids, teens, young adults, and families to achieve goals

  • Experienced in brief, goal-focused psychotherapy using measurement based care 

  • Grounded in cultural humility with a commitment to culturally responsive care 

  • Experience with video therapy and providing supervision/consultation on how to conduct clinical sessions via video conferencing software

  • Comfort with technology and working within a fast-moving environment 

  • Excellent interpersonal skills (listening and communicating)

  • Passion for transforming mental health through technology with a human touch 

  • Ability to work full-time, approximately 40 hours per week

    About the Opportunity

    Lyra’s provider network is composed of in-person and virtual therapists, physicians, and coaches across the US. With our advanced matching technology, supportive provider platform, and opportunities for training and clinical consultation, being part of our network is an incredible chance to do what you love (like patient care) with support for the things you don’t love (like self promotion and scheduling).

    We are looking for contract nurse practitioners (NPs) or certified physician assistants (PA-C) who are passionate about whole-person, whole family mental health care and working within a connected network to provide patients with easily accessible, culturally responsive, high-quality mental health care. 

    As a contract provider, you’ll provide evidence-based treatment via intake appointments and regular follow-up appointments. You'll conduct psychiatric evaluations and provide medication management. Lyra makes it easy to refer patients to therapy and coaching services in tandem with your care.

    You will provide care to individuals from a multitude of different backgrounds and experiences, as well as those with varying needs and abilities. We strive to continue to meet their unique needs by delivering culturally-responsive care—an approach that is mindful of the impact of cultural background on each person’s care experience.

    We’re currently prioritizing hiring in Delaware, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania.
